description: UPTET Answer Key 2026: The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the UPTET Provisional Answer Key 2026 and opened the online objection window until July 14. Candidates can download the answer key, verify their responses and estimate their scores. Objections must be submitted online with supporting documents, as offline requests will not be accepted. After reviewing all challenges, the commission will publish the final answer key, which will be used to prepare the UPTET Result 2026.
title: UPTET answer key released: Objection window open until July 14

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Delhi received heavy rainfall early Thursday, extending the monsoon spell and bringing relief. An orange alert forecasts more rain across the region through most of the day. This continuous rainfall caused waterlogging in several parts of the national capital. Similar weather is expected over Haryana, Chandigarh, and west Uttar Pradesh until July tenth. Northeast Uttar Pradesh will see rain until July thirteenth, and east Rajasthan on July ninth.
title: Delhi-NCR wakes up to another rainy morning; IMD issues orange alert

author: MAHIMA ROY
description: The Vancouver Canucks have been actively looking for trade options for the team’s star center Elias Pettersson as the team rebuilds its roster, ahead of the new season. Elias Pettersson’s performance has also dropped in the last few years which has sparked some concern. Amid all the mess, it seems the Pittsburgh Penguins and the Philadelphia Flyers have emerged as potential landing spots for him.
title: NHL trade rumor: Penguins, Flyers eye Canucks' $92M star

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Global oil markets are experiencing renewed chaos as crude prices surged significantly. US President Donald Trump declared the ceasefire agreement with Iran was over. Fresh US military strikes on Iranian targets heightened fears of supply disruptions. Maritime authorities raised the threat level for vessels transiting the strait. The rise in oil prices renews concerns over inflation and potential interest rate hikes.
title: Crude nears $80 a barrel again after Trump declares US-Iran ceasefire ‘over’

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: British wildcard Arthur Fery has reached the Wimbledon semifinals in a remarkable achievement. He defeated Flavio Cobolli to become only the second men's singles wildcard in history to do so. Fery's surprising run has earned the nickname "Ferytale" among fans and media. He will now face second seed Alexander Zverev in the next round.
title: Hometown hero Fery makes Wimbledon history as second wild card ever to reach semis

title: Nearly 1,000 cyclospora cases reported in Michigan in largest-ever parasite outbreak

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Young Indian tennis player Arnav Paparkar reached the Wimbledon boys' singles quarterfinals. He became the first Indian in 36 years to achieve this prestigious feat. Paparkar defeated Japan's Ryo Tabata in a dominant performance on Wednesday. This historic achievement places him among elite Indian tennis players. He will now face American qualifier Jordan Lee in the next round.
title: Who is Arnav Paparkar? Meet the first Indian in 36 years to reach Wimbledon quarterfinals

author: MAHIMA ROY
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce just had the wedding of the year as 1000 high profile guests belonging to Hollywood and the sports world lined up to watch the pop star walk down the aisle, sparking chaos among milllions. While the wedding had brought New York City to a standstill, it seems Blake Lively might not have been that disappointed with not being invited.
title: Blake Lively didn't expect this from Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce: Report

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: A Mumbai woman's finger was successfully replanted after a severe door crush injury. Doctors performed complex microsurgery to restore circulation to the amputated digit. The patient had significant medical challenges including diabetes and tobacco use. This case highlights the advancements in modern microsurgery for limb salvage. Early referral and specialized treatment are crucial for successful replantation outcomes.
title: Woman nearly loses finger after door slams shut on her, doctors replant it within hours

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Peter Dinklage gained global fame for his role as Tyrion Lannister. He largely keeps his private life away from the public eye. Dinklage discussed his evolving confidence and relationships with women. He believes women often see through superficial things more easily. Upcoming films for the celebrated actor include 'Idiots' and 'The Reckoner'.
title: Quote of the day by Peter Dinklage: 'Women are not as shallow as men are...'

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Alpha continues its theatrical run, nearing the Rs 75 crore worldwide milestone. The action thriller earned an estimated Rs 2.85 crore net in India on Wednesday. Its India net collection reached Rs 44.95 crore and overseas gross Rs 21.30 crore. The film's worldwide gross collection now stands at Rs 74.89 crore globally. It aims to cross Rs 100 crore worldwide after the upcoming weekend.
title: 'Alpha' nears Rs 75 crore mark at box office on Day 6

title: 'Symbol of our shared confidence': PM Modi pitches stronger India-Australia ties in Melbourne

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Cristiano Ronaldo's FIFA World Cup journey concluded after Portugal's Round of 16 loss to Spain. He shared an emotional message on Instagram, stating "Portugal Forever" after the match. Ronaldo became the oldest player to appear in a World Cup knockout game at 41. He also set a record for most shots without creating a chance. This marked the end of his illustrious World Cup career.
title: Cristiano Ronaldo's two-word message after Portugal's World Cup exit

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: The Federal Communications Commission has officially placed Digitalsystem Technology on its national security risk list, consequently prohibiting the company from offering international telecommunications services. This decision arises from concerns about its affiliations with Chinese telecom firms and ownership stakes. The FCC highlighted the potential for exploitation by Chinese threat actors as a significant threat, emphasizing the determination of significant and unacceptable national security risks.
title: California-based tech company 'banned' for Chinese links

author: TNN
description: Champat Rai claims Anil Mishra and SBI officials framed SOPs without his approval.  Mishra allegedly handled administrative and financial powers with SBI, leading to mismanagement.  The usual currency note handling codes may not have been followed by bank staff.  An agreement was made with SBI's Ayodhya branch chief during Maha Kumbh.  Rai stated all other correspondence with SBI was handled by him since August 2020.
title: Champat Rai’s ‘letter’ to SIT blames Anil Mishra for mismanagement

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Brittany Mahomes faced online backlash after some social media users wrongly believed she wore a white dress to Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's wedding. The criticism stemmed from lighting in her photos and older images from the 2023 Met Gala being mistakenly shared as her wedding look. In reality, Brittany wore a baby blue dress, not white, making the viral controversy a case of misinformation fueled by misleading images.
title: Fans slam Brittany Mahomes over alleged white outfit at Taylor Swift’s wedding

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Popular American fitness influencer and YouTuber Connor Murphy has died at the age of 32 after a drowning incident in Thailand. In the wake of his death, a video widely shared on X as his "last video" has gone viral, but the clip has since been clarified as an old recording. The video showed Murphy speaking directly to the camera, saying he felt like he was "dying every second."
title: Connor Murphy's alleged last video saying 'I'm dying every second' resurfaces after his death

author: SUMIT ROY
description: Connor Murphy died in Thailand after reportedly fleeing police and entering a lake, where he later drowned. Newly released images from his rental home show trash, medication packets and damage inside the property. Police are still investigating the case and awaiting autopsy and toxicology results. Authorities have not confirmed what led to Murphy’s behavior before his death.
title: Chilling new images reveal condition of Connor Murphy’s Thailand home before drowning death

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: The England-India Test, beginning on Friday, will be the first women's Test at Lord's. It comes 142 years after the ground hosted its first men's Test.
title: Ind vs Eng: 142 years after men's, Lord's hosts first-ever Women's Test

author: SANJIB CHAKRABORTY
description: A husband allegedly murdered his wife by slitting her throat in Sodepur. He then attempted suicide by stabbing himself and is in critical condition. The couple had been experiencing marital discord for some time. Geeta had recently left her matrimonial home and returned to Sodepur. Police are investigating the incident and reviewing CCTV footage.
title: Bengal shocker: Man slits wife's throat on busy road, attempts suicide

author: TNN
description: Large parts of Surat remained submerged on Wednesday after heavy rains eased. Stagnant water choked roads, homes, and commercial complexes, causing significant disruption. Overflowing creeks spilled into neighborhoods, leaving many areas inundated with waist-deep water. Transport networks suffered as buses and vehicles remained stranded in floodwaters. Rescue operations continued, and schools and industries remained shut due to the ongoing situation.
title: 13 killed in Surat rains: Floodwaters continue to inundate homes, markets and roads

author: CHAITANYA MARPAKWAR
description: NCP (SP) chief Sharad Pawar met deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde, creating political stir.  Arif Naseem Khan also held a closed-door meeting with Pawar to gauge his political mood.  Rumors of Pawar's party joining the Mahayuti are circulating among Congress insiders.  Congress is working to reclaim political space if Pawar's party shifts alliances.  Pawar's party remains a constituent of the INDIA alliance, according to Congress.
title: Stir in Mumbai's political circles as Sharad Pawar meets Eknath Shinde

author: TNN
description: A travelling ticket examiner was suspended after a train coupe was decorated for a couple.  The compartment was adorned with balloons and flowers, creating a honeymoon suite ambiance.  Authorities ordered an inquiry into the incident which occurred at Jalna railway station.  An event styling service decorated the coupe, and the decorator faced charges.  The railway views the decorator's entry as a serious unauthorized lapse.
title: Watch: First AC coupe of express train turns into ‘honeymoon suite’; TTE suspended
